name: Assault Rifle
description: The Assault Rifle is a state-of-the-art piece of hardware. It is equipped to handle an impressive arsenal of munitions and firing modes. The Assault Rifle is also equipped with the latest in targeting technology, and is a very accurate weapon.

powers.name: Single Shot
powers.description: A quick single shot from the Assault rifle. Damage: Minor, Recharge: Fast

powers.name: Burst
powers.description: Quickly fires a Burst of rounds at a single target at very long range. will also reduce the target's defense. Damage: Moderate(DoT), Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Buckshot
powers.description: Good at close range. Fires a cone of Buckshot pellets and can knock some foes down. Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Slug
powers.description: Fires a single Slug at a targeted foe. Firing a single Slug is slower than firing a Burst, but deals more damage, is longer range, will knock down and disorient foes. Damage: High, Recharge: Moderate
powers.shortHelp: Ranged, High DMG(Lethal), Foe Knockback, Disorient

powers.name: M30 Grenade
powers.description: Launches a Grenade at long range from beneath the barrel of your Assault Rifle. This explosion affects all within the blast radius, and can knock them back. Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Ignite
powers.description: Sprays a targeted location with accelerant from your flamethrower, igniting the location. Any foes that pass through the flames will be burned. Great for blocking doorways and small passages. Damage: Moderate(DoT), Recharge: Fast

powers.name: Flamethrower
powers.description: Spews forth a cone of flames from underneath the barrel of your assault rifle, setting foes on fire. Very accurate and very deadly at medium range. Damage: Extreme(DoT) Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Sniper Rifle
powers.description: Sniper Rifle is a powerful piece of hardware. It is very accurate and has a very long range. The impressive round can knock down its target. Like most sniper attacks, you must take your time to aim, so this attack can be interrupted. If used in conjunction with a targeting drone, the Sniper Rifle will do additional damage. If you have more than 97% To-Hit, this attack becomes instant-cast.  Damage: Extreme, Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Full Auto
powers.description: Opens up your assault rifle on Full Auto to lay down a massive spray of bullets at your target. Although very slow to reload, damage from this attack is massive, shredding all targets within the narrow cone of effect. There's a chance you may land a lucky shot for extra damage. Damage: Superior(DoT), Recharge: Slow
